_comment: Copy the "Mudbase" section below into MudbaseShowcase.DocsSearch/appsettings.Development.json (or set the equivalent Mudbase__<Key> environment variables in production) with your own provisioned project's values. ProjectId/collection/function ids are NOT secrets (see README.md) - FunctionsApiKey and AnthropicApiKey ARE secrets and must never be committed with a real value.

Mudbase._comment_functionId: The _id of the deployed 'docsAskRetrieval' Function in this project - see README.md 'Provisioning'.
Mudbase._comment_functionsApiKey: SECRET - an org-scoped ak_ API key permissioned only for "functions" (create+read), required by the Function's /execute route. Create one from the Mudbase dashboard's API Keys page for this project's org, or via POST /api/api-keys with { "project": "<projectId>", "permissions": [{ "resource": "functions", "actions": ["create","read"] }] } using an owner/admin/developer-role account. Set via the Mudbase__FunctionsApiKey environment variable - never commit a real value here.
Mudbase._comment_anthropicApiKey: SECRET - get a key from https://console.anthropic.com, see README.md 'LLM setup'. Set via the Mudbase__AnthropicApiKey environment variable - never commit a real value here, and never put it inside the Mudbase Function's own environment variables (the Function's sandbox has no network access - see plan/build-plan.md).
Mudbase._comment_llmModel: Optional - defaults to claude-opus-5 if unset. A cheaper/faster demo model such as claude-sonnet-5 or claude-haiku-4-5 also works.
